content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that if you take sets close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank), loads from roughly 30% of your 1RM up to your max can build similar muscle. Lighter loads just take more reps and tend to hurt more.

Your bench goal is different, though. To hit 100 kg, you need to practice heavy sets, because strength is specific to the load and skill you train. I'd mix heavy work (3-6 reps) on your main bench with moderate rep ranges (8-15) on accessories for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
